wikipedia_summary: El pinzón azul de Gran Canaria es una especie de ave paseriforme de la familia de los fringílidos (Fringillidae) endémico de esta isla.
fallback_text: Endemic to the island of Gran Canaria in the Canary Islands. Medium-sized finch with a strong and heavy bill, broken white eyering, and bold white wing-bars. Male is a striking dark blue-gray while female is brown-gray. Largely restricted to montane pine forests. Song is a repetitive, accelerating series; call is a quiet, rising “weep.”
